limits: Mapping contains the 279 named parts in the pinned official mixer-playground source; newer cosmetic parts absent from that source are not fabricated.
Eye and ear parts do not have Axie Classic battle cards and therefore have null cardId.
Each sprite is an exact atlas region rendered with the official shader and a default class-02 palette; the user Axie gene palette may differ.
Ears use one authentic left-ear image where available, otherwise the right-ear image; atlasKey records the exact choice.
visualInspection: All 132 standard battle sprites inspected across six class contact sheets; recognizable, uncropped authentic atlas art. Native small mouth textures remain at source resolution.
